context.transcript:
I wanted to go over the recent production figures at our four steel factories before I make my presentation at the Board of Directors meeting next week.
Our factories at Franklin and Hollister both met their projected quotas for February and March.
Output at the Centerville factory, however, declined unexpectedly.
Production at Centerville was strong in February but was down to only 2,000 tons in March.
Now, I have no figures for the Springfield factory because it was closed for more than a month due to damage caused by storms.
But everything is repaired now so Springfield will be back in business soon.
context.transcript_translation:
在我在下周董事会会议上做演示之前，我想回顾一下我们在四个钢铁厂的近期产量数据。
位于Franklin和Hollister的工厂在二月和三月都达到了预期的配额。
然而，Centerville工厂的产出意外下降了。
Centerville工厂二月的产量很强劲，但在三月只降到了2,000吨。
现在，我没有Springfield工厂的数据，因为它因为风暴造成的损坏而关闭了一个多月。
但现在一切都修好了，所以Springfield很快就能恢复运营了。
